blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: Many people dream of discovering everything Tanzania has to offer. Whether it’s an epic Tanzania safari in search of Africa’s Big Five, a Kilimanjaro climb or some time on Zanzibar’s paradise beaches, Tanzania has the lot. The good news is that Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom-made itinerary that meets all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: For inspiration, take a look at our most popular itineraries. Most of our guests like to finish their exciting safari with a few relaxing days on one of Zanzibar’s most beautiful beaches. Is that something you’d enjoy too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: Whether you go for one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or would rather tailor your own trip, we’re here to help. Join us and get ready to discover Tanzania at your own pace, exactly as you wish!

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: Our Your Tanzania Trip guide is waiting for you when you land at Kilimanjaro International Airport. He takes you to your hotel, where you can rest after the flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: Before the climb begins you meet your guide, who gives you a briefing along with advice on clothing, packing and other useful tips to make the climb as comfortable as it can be.

blocks.orig: Today you start your incredible journey via the Lemosho Route. Your guide picks you up in the morning and takes you on an approximately 4-hour drive to the western entrance of Kilimanjaro National Park (2,200 m). The road leads through a beautiful tropical rainforest after which you arrive at the drop-off point at 3,500 meters where you can admire the beautiful Shira plateau. The walking route to the first camp is flat which allows you to get used to the high altitude.
blocks.html: Your remarkable journey along the Lemosho Route begins today. In the morning your guide collects you and drives you for about 4 hours to the western gate of Kilimanjaro National Park (2,200 m). The road winds through lovely tropical rainforest before reaching the drop-off point at 3,500 metres, where you can take in the beautiful Shira plateau. The walk to the first camp is level, which helps you adjust to the high altitude.

blocks.orig: In the morning you depart from Shira 1 Camp (3,505 m) to Shira 2 Camp (3,900 m). This walk is not difficult and you can enjoy the breathtaking landscapes and the unique flora of Kilimanjaro's surroundings as you climb higher. On a clear day, Shira 2 Camp is the perfect location to see Mount Meru (the fifth peak of Africa). After lunch, take an acclimatization walk to Lava Tower Camp (elevation gain of 200m) to increase the chances to summit and reduce the chances of altitude sickness.
blocks.html: This morning you set off from Shira 1 Camp (3,505 m) towards Shira 2 Camp (3,900 m). The walk is not hard, and as you gain height you can enjoy the stunning scenery and the unusual plant life around Kilimanjaro. When the sky is clear, Shira 2 Camp is the ideal spot to see Mount Meru (Africa’s fifth peak). After lunch you go on an acclimatisation walk to Lava Tower Camp (an elevation gain of 200m), which improves your chances of reaching the summit and lowers the risk of altitude sickness.

blocks.orig: From Shira Camp 2 to the beautiful Lava Tower at 4,630 m (15,190 ft), you go through many ascents and descents with amazing views along the way. You have lunch at Lava Tower for one to two hours for your body to acclimatize as you might feel uncomfortable with the increase in altitude. After lunch, you descend to Barranco Camp. Watch out for strange-looking flowering plants that grow up to five meters high! Barranco Camp is located at the foot of the imposing Barranco Wall, which is impressive in both its sheer size and steepness.
blocks.html: Between Shira Camp 2 and the beautiful Lava Tower at 4,630 m (15,190 ft) there are plenty of ups and downs, with wonderful views as you go. Lunch at Lava Tower lasts one to two hours so your body can acclimatise, as the extra altitude may make you feel uncomfortable. After lunch you walk down to Barranco Camp. Look out for odd-looking flowering plants that can reach five metres in height! Barranco Camp lies at the foot of the towering Barranco Wall, impressive for both its sheer size and its steepness.

blocks.orig: After breakfast, you depart from Barranco Camp to the Barranco Wall. For many people, this is their favourite part of the climb. Once at the top of the Barranco Wall, you have a spectacular view of the Kibo Volcano and Mount Meru.
blocks.html: Following breakfast, you leave Barranco Camp and head for the Barranco Wall. Many people consider this the best part of the whole climb. From the top of the Barranco Wall you get a spectacular view of the Kibo Volcano and Mount Meru.

blocks.orig: Afterwards, a more difficult hike starts to reach Karanga Camp. This route has many ascents and descents, so keep the right pace. You have lunch at the camp and after a rest, you can take an acclimatization hike in the direction of Barafu Camp.
blocks.html: Next comes a tougher hike to Karanga Camp. The trail goes up and down a lot, so make sure you keep a steady pace. Lunch is served at the camp, and after resting you can go on an acclimatisation hike towards Barafu Camp.

blocks.orig: Barafu Camp is the starting point for your ascent to the Uhuru Peak - the top of Kilimanjaro! You start after breakfast and arrive at the camp around lunch. Have a rest and after you regain your strength, take an acclimatization hike to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870m) and back. Enjoy breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks and experience the thrill of high-altitude camping as you prepare for the final push to the summit around midnight.
blocks.html: From Barafu Camp you begin your ascent to Uhuru Peak - the summit of Kilimanjaro! You leave after breakfast and reach the camp at around lunchtime. Take a rest and, once you’ve regained your energy, do an acclimatisation hike to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870m) and back. Take in the superb views of the surrounding peaks and enjoy the excitement of camping at high altitude while you get ready for the final push to the top around midnight.

blocks.orig: Today is the day! Around midnight you start from Barafu Camp to Uhuru Peak. The climb leads over good trails and the most challenging part is the high altitude. Once you reach the summit you can enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is quite impressive at this height! After a short time at the top, where you celebrate your ultimate triumph, you descend slowly to the scenic Millennium Camp.
blocks.html: This is the big day! At around midnight you leave Barafu Camp for Uhuru Peak. The trails are good, and the hardest part is the high altitude. When you reach the summit you’re rewarded with a beautiful sunrise, which is truly impressive at this height! After a short while at the top celebrating your achievement, you make your way slowly down to the scenic Millennium Camp.

blocks.orig: The Millennium camp is located in a tropical rainforest. When you wake up today, you feel a sense of relief from the reduced altitude and satisfaction from reaching the summit. After breakfast, you take an easy walk to the park exit.
blocks.html: Millennium camp lies in a tropical rainforest. Waking up this morning, you feel relieved by the lower altitude and satisfied at having reached the summit. After breakfast, an easy walk brings you to the park exit.

blocks.orig: Your driver then takes you back to the hotel for a well-deserved rest!
blocks.html: From there your driver brings you back to the hotel for some well-earned rest!

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately, your holiday has come to an end and it’s time to travel home. Make the most of your final hours in Tanzania until our driver picks you up and brings you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still want more? You can also add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
